title: PUT performs full replacement, not partial update

suggestion: Spec-conformant (R5 only asks to update). Document the replace semantics or support partial PATCH if partial updates are expected.

title: ?author= filter is a case-insensitive substring (LIKE) match
evidence: src/app.ts:44 'WHERE author LIKE ? COLLATE NOCASE' with '%author%'
